questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: The Aboriginal peoples are one of the oldest surviving cultures in the world, and are simultaneously being structurally discriminated, with their culture being destroyed. I wanted to understand the nuances of the conflict and write my bachelor's thesis on the subject.

questions.answer: Food and drink here are expensive, and housing is also. You pay weekly, so SU might not always be there at the right time. Make sure to have some backup money

questions.answer: Food was more expensive, but eating out is less than in Copenhagen. Transport is cheaper too
